'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Justin Kaufman DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Kaufman]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title DS II.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Kaufman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
